title: Evaluating the Linear Equation y = mx + b in Scheme
description: Define a three-parameter lambda function for a linear equation using nested prefix arithmetic.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Lines 1-3 bind `y` to `(lambda (m x b) (+ (* x m) b))`, taking slope `m`, input `x`, and intercept `b`.
Look at `(+ (* x m) b)` on line 3. In prefix notation, the inner call `(* x m)` computes the product first. It passes that number as the first argument to the outer `+` alongside `b`.

steps.question: When `(y 5 6 7)` runs on line 5, which numbers bind to `m`, `x`, and `b`, and what value does `(+ (* x m) b)` return?
steps.answer: `m` is `5`, `x` is `6`, and `b` is `7`. `(* 6 5)` evaluates to the product, and adding `7` returns `37`.
